title: Tight Asymptotic Bounds on the Maximum Number of Linear Regions of Piecewise-Linear Kolmogorov--Arnold networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.07973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Schoots et al.~\citep{schoots2025relating} (AISTATS 2025) established a generally loose upper bound on the number of linear regions of continuous piecewise-linear (CPWL) Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs), without providing a lower bound. We consider a $T$-layer network with width vector $\mathbf n=(n_0,\ldots,n_T)$, input dimension $n_0=d$, output width $n_T=1$, and at most $k\geq2$ affine segments per edge. Our matching upper and lower bounds determine the tight growth order $\Theta_{\mathbf n}(k^{\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}\rho_{\ell-1}})$ in $k$, where $\rho_{\ell-1}:=\min_{0\leq s\leq\ell-1}n_s$. When every hidden width is at least $d$, the tight order simplifies to $\Theta_{\mathbf n}(k^{dT})$. The upper bound of \citep{schoots2025relating} is $k^{\sum_{\ell=1}^{T}n_{\ell-1}n_\ell}$. translated_title: 分段线性Kolmogorov–Arnold网络线性区域最大数量的紧致渐近界
translated_abstract: Schoots等人（AISTATS 2025）针对连续分段线性（CPWL）Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（KAN）的线性区域数量建立了一个通常较为宽松的上界，但并未给出相应的下界。我们考虑一个T层网络，其宽度向量为n=(n₀,…,n_T)，输入维度n₀=d，输出宽度n_T=1，且每条边上至多有k≥2个仿射段。我们给出的相互匹配的上界和下界确定了关于k的紧致增长阶Θ_n(k^(Σ_{ℓ=1}^{T}ρ_{ℓ-1}))，其中ρ_{ℓ-1}:=min_{0≤s≤ℓ-1}n_s。当每个隐藏层宽度都至少为d时，该紧致阶可简化为Θ_n(k^(dT))。Schoots等人给出的上界为k^(Σ_{ℓ=1}^{T}n_{ℓ-1}n_ℓ)。我们的上界将其改进了一个Θ_n(k^(Σ_{ℓ=1}^{T}n_{ℓ-1}n_ℓ-Σ_{ℓ=1}^{T}ρ_{ℓ-1}))的因子，并且严格……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次为分段线性Kolmogorov–Arnold网络的线性区域最大数量给出了相互匹配的上下界，确定了紧致增长阶Θ_n(k^(Σρ))，从而大幅改进了此前文献中宽松的上界并首次补齐了下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes matching upper and lower bounds on the maximum number of linear regions of piecewise-linear Kolmogorov–Arnold networks, determining the tight growth order Θ_n(k^(Σρ)) and thereby significantly tightening the previously loose upper bound while providing the first lower bound.
